enterMonthlyBillsDescription: Pick a year tab. Every energy carrier is one row — enter the reading in its own native unit (m³ for gas, Gcal for district heat, kg for coal, kWh for electricity); one tariff applies to the whole year. Copy a row from Excel and paste it straight into the table — or download the template, fill it in, and upload it back.
